summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Builder-Mode Live Stripe MRR/ARR widget. Backend: 8/8 new tests PASS in test_stripe_metrics.py — (a) monthly Creator → mrr=699, (b) yearly Business @ €10,788/yr → mrr=899 (yearly/12), (c) Business + 5 seats @ €4.99 → mrr=923.95 and seats_mrr_eur=24.95, weekly interval → ×52/12, plan_breakdown ordering exactly Starter→Creator→Business→Agency→Enterprise Basic→Enterprise Plus→Enterprise Advanced→Other, and arr_eur == 12*mrr_eur in every case. API authz on GET /api/founder/stripe-metrics: anonymous→401, non-founder→403, founder→200 with full shape (active_subs, mrr_eur, arr_eur, seats_mrr_eur, plan_breakdown, seat_breakdown, currency='eur', fetched_at) returning empty pre-launch state in <8s. Regression: 84 passed, 1 skipped (76 prior + 8 new = 84) — no regressions. Frontend: founder login via TOTP works, /dashboard renders, switch-mode toggles Builder Mode, stripe-metrics-card appears beneath the four StatCards, shows 3 totals tiles (ACTIVE SUBS=0, MRR=€0, ARR=€0) with EUR formatting, renders stripe-metrics-empty state ('No active subscriptions yet. Numbers will populate as soon as your first customer completes checkout.'), no plan-breakdown table. Refresh button refetches and the 'updated HH:MM:SS' label changes (7:54:38→7:54:40). Non-founder regression confirmed: a freshly-signed-up non-founder user sees NO switch-mode, NO builder-panel, NO stripe-metrics-card on /dashboard, and direct fetch of /api/founder/stripe-metrics from that browser returns 403 {detail:'Founder only'}. Founder 2FA TOTP secret + billing_exempt + Enterprise Unlimited plan fully restored at end of test. Test users (TEST_metrics_*, test_nonf_*) cleaned up — 8 rows removed.

issues: Spinner inside refresh button is only visible if the API call is slow. Against the pre-launch Stripe account the response returns in <300ms so the spinner is almost imperceptible. Not a bug — purely a perception note. Consider adding a min-spin-duration of 400ms for nicer UX.

critical_code_review_comments: stripe_subscriptions.compute_stripe_mrr — pagination loop uses page.has_more + starting_after correctly; expand=['data.items.data.price'] avoids per-sub price round-trips. Good.

Yearly→monthly division is plain float / 12 then round(.,2). This is fine for our €-cent precision but for a sub priced at e.g. €100/yr it produces 8.33 (=100/12 rounded); the ARR computation then does 12 * 8.33 = 99.96, drifting €0.04 from the real €100/yr. Not a blocker — at our actual price points (10,788/yr → 899.00 exact) there is no drift. If exact ARR matching matters later, track annual_mrr separately and compute ARR from raw annual.
server.py:1185 endpoint surfaces RuntimeError as 503 and other Stripe errors as 502 — correct error taxonomy.
StripeMetricsCard.jsx — useEffect deps array is [] so initial fetch is once; React.StrictMode in dev would double-fire, but axios call is idempotent (read-only). Acceptable.

StripeMetricsCard.jsx — formatEur drops decimals when n >= 1000, so e.g. €1234.50 displays as '1,235'. Fine for MRR/ARR but the plan-breakdown table reuses the same helper — a high-revenue plan row would also lose its cents. Minor UX nit; not a functional bug.

All interactive elements (stripe-metrics-card, stripe-metrics-totals, stripe-metrics-refresh, stripe-metrics-empty, stripe-metrics-breakdown, stripe-row-<plan>, stripe-metrics-seats) carry data-testid attributes — testability is excellent.
